visual_review: Inspected final full PNG and 512px JPEG. Pepe keeps his wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes. Both inherited hands have four fingers and one thumb. New flint and impression use charcoal and red ochre; no text, numerals, logos, watermark, borders, real people or prohibited symbols observed. Ancestor marks remain outside the added patch.
unmet_visual_requirements: Inherited rock looks photographic; it was preserved to retain the cave.
visual_limitations: Charcoal impression is subdued against the dark upper-right rock, especially at thumbnail scale.
